I also did not find direct evidence of the spending being used to intimidate neighbors beyond standard NATO deterrence language.","evidence":[{"title":"Bundesverteidigungsminister Pistorius zum Haushaltsgesetz 2024","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"31 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/verteidigungsminister-haushalt-2257432","summary":"Pistorius said the 2024 budget would provide about 72 billion euros for the Bundeswehr, the highest value in the Bundeswehr’s history, and framed this as a sign that Germany takes its security and defense seriously. The same statement says the regular defense budget will be 80 billion euros from 2028, with more money for police equipment and disaster management. This strongly supports a real-security rationale.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Press conference on the 2025 budget","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"5 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116","summary":"Scholz described the budget as providing “security and stability in times of unrest and insecurity,” linking military and internal-security spending to public safety rather than prestige or patronage.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.7","1B.8"]},{"title":"National Security Strategy","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"2024 archive page, strategy adopted 2023","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356","summary":"Scholz said the strategy was a “systematic overall approach” and not just a narrow defense white paper. It explicitly includes diplomacy, police, fire brigades, civil protection, cyber security, supply-chain resilience, and pandemic prevention. This shows mobilization aimed at broad risk reduction, not personal strength projection.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.7","1B.9"]},{"title":"Rede von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"6 Sep 2023, operative in 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2166814","summary":"Scholz said the 100 billion euro special fund for the Bundeswehr created a durable shift in capabilities and stressed that the money should be invested sustainably in equipment, ammunition, training, and personnel. This is the clearest evidence that the spending program was framed as capability-building, not patronage.","question_ids":["2B.8","1B.7"]},{"title":"Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"2023 statement, still operative in 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/bulletin/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2198328","summary":"Scholz said the Bundeswehr must be strengthened to become a guarantor of conventional defense in Europe and that Germany was investing for its own security, not only to satisfy allies.
